title: World Bloom — Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future — Episode5 Us Back Then

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future
meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGER version of Leo/need's debut song is generating buzz, and Ichika and the others couldn't be happier. As the band renews their vow to make it as pros, a new area appears in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It looks like a station platform...
There's even a train and a set of tracks...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's really something, isn't it?
I was just as surprised the first time I came here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, if you look carefully here and there, you'll notice a few odd things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
This train has no destination...
Same with the electronic bulletin board...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Exactly.
And look where the tracks go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They extend out towards that starry sky...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's incredible! It's like you can ride this train to the stars...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh.
I didn't realize you were here, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Len!
I didn't know you'd be here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I came to see what this new area's all about.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, why did it appear out of the blue like this...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't have any specifics... But I think it has to do with you and the others' feelings, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: After all, this SEKAI was born out of them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But what feelings would those be...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No idea. It may have to do with something that you and the others haven't realized yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think I see some people on the other platform. It looks like...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Please don't talk to me at school anymore.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: What? Why don't you want to talk to me?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: I already made up with my classmates, so you don't have to worry about me. Okay?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, I don't get it... Wait!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, wait! It's not what you think!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I don't know what our past selves are doing over there...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I don't want Ichika to look so sad!!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to get over to that platform.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't want her to feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What you said to me then made me so happy!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'd become an outcast in class...!
And I absolutely dreaded going to school each day...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you worked up the courage to come talk to me. You showed genuine concern...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You don't know how happy that made me!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And yet...
I couldn't find the same courage...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That day, I caused Ichika a lot of pain...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I can't change that fact.
And I can't ask for her forgiveness...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I can change the future.
If I can learn to become stronger, be more courageous and know when to act...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll be able to do more for everyone next time.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're able to put into words what you couldn't back then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, there's no need for you to worry or feel scared.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Just keep moving straight forward.
You'll become stronger and lead everyone in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've been able to become stronger bit by bit thanks to the others in Leo/need and everyone here in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm sure there'll be plenty more tough times and moments when I question myself in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Because I want to keep moving forward with everyone...!!)
